optimizedContext.value:
# Initialize Persisted Spec State

## Rules

- `InitializePersistedSpecState.execute(input)`: async; input `InitializePersistedSpecStateInput` with `target: { kind: 'spec', specId } | { kind: 'all', workspaces? }` and optional `schemaRef`.
- Schema: resolve provided `schemaRef` explicitly; otherwise effective project schema. Resolve/apply exactly one schema per invocation; differing subsets require separate targeted calls.
- Per target: resolve schema once through Core composition for whole invocation; discover raw identity without metadata materialization; read aggregate persisted-state snapshot; reject any existing state with `SpecAlreadyInitializedError` regardless of schema identity; load/parse schema-declared canonical `scope: spec` artifacts; resolve dependencies via shared `resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn()`; call `applyPersistedSpecStatePatch()` with `{ kind: 'initial', schema, dependsOn }` base plus empty patch; conditionally write complete state using `expectedRevision: null`.
- Initial `dependsOn` precedence: caller-supplied complete value (for example accompanying `deps set`/`deps clear` intent or archive publication plan); else fresh deterministic projection of current canonical artifacts under selected schema; else `[]` when extraction yields no value. Reuse `GenerateSpecMetadata` deterministic projection directly; never persist intermediate cache or read persisted metadata snapshot.
- Never import dependency, optimization, or implementation values from metadata cache. Initialize `implementation: []`; omit `optimizations`; derive `dependsOn` only from current artifact projection.
- Write lock only; never eagerly materialize/persist metadata. Next normal metadata consumer self-heals stale cache.
- One-time only: no `--force`, schema reassignment, or reinitialization. Single-spec existing state always throws `SpecAlreadyInitializedError`.
- Batch `target.kind: 'all'`: preselect lock-less specs, optionally by `workspaces`; exclude initialized specs. Continue all eligible targets despite failures. Return `initialized`, `failed` with per-spec detail, and `existingSkipped` count. Any eligible failure makes overall outcome failure despite partial success. Read-only workspace targets are failures, never skipped/existing.
- Concurrency: `expectedRevision: null` must reject state created after selection.
- Standard Core composition: class with async `execute(input)`, explicit constructor dependencies; expose `InitializePersistedSpecStateDeps`, `resolveInitializePersistedSpecStateDeps(resolver: CompositionResolver): InitializePersistedSpecStateDeps`, `createInitializePersistedSpecState(deps): InitializePersistedSpecState`, and `createInitializePersistedSpecState(config: SpecdConfig, options?: CompositionResolutionOptions): InitializePersistedSpecState`.
- Resolver dependencies include workspace `SpecRepository` instances, `ListWorkspaces`, schema resolution via `GetActiveSchema`, shared `resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn()` built on `GenerateSpecMetadata` deterministic projection/content extraction. Config factory creates one `CompositionResolver`, resolves deps, delegates to canonical deps factory.
- Export `InitializePersistedSpecState`, Input/Result types, Deps, and `create*` factory through Core public surface; SDK re-export; expose `Kernel.specs.initializePersistedState`.

## Constraints

- Initialize persisted state only for existing artifacts; never create spec artifacts.
- Same shared `resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn()` must serve this use case, incidental first-lock creation in mutation use cases, and `ArchiveChange`; no local reimplementation.
- Never construct legacy fallback `{ schema: { name: 'unknown', version: 0 } }`.
